component.name: Strata
component.summary: Play the music on your own machine

description.p: Strata is a local-first music player. It reads tags from the files you already have, keeps its library in a local SQLite database, and never modifies, renames or moves your music.

ul.li: Browse tracks, albums, artists, folders, favourites and playlists
Queue, shuffle, repeat, gapless playback and session restore
Playlists, including M3U, M3U8 and XSPF import and export
Every keyboard shortcut can be rebound
Rescan in place: files that moved are re-identified instead of duplicated

description.p: Everything happens on the machine: no accounts, no telemetry, no network access.
